csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using UnityEngine.UI; using System.Text; using System.Linq; using UnityEditor; public class Script { public static string Main() { var sb = new StringBuilder(); var allGos = Resources.FindObjectsOfTypeAll<GameObject>(); string[] btnNames = new string[] { "SpinButton", "DriverButton", "GolfinButton" }; foreach (var btnName in btnNames) { var go = allGos.FirstOrDefault(g => g.name == btnName && g.scene.IsValid()); if (go == null) { sb.AppendLine(btnName + ": NOT FOUND"); continue; } var iconArea = go.transform.Find("IconArea"); if (iconArea == null) { sb.AppendLine(btnName + ": no IconArea"); continue; } var rt = iconArea.GetComponent<RectTransform>(); rt.anchorMin = new Vector2(0.5f, 1f); rt.anchorMax = new Vector2(0.5f, 1f); rt.pivot = new Vector2(0.5f, 1f); rt.anchoredPosition = Vector2.zero; rt.sizeDelta = new Vector2(135f, 120f); sb.AppendLine(btnName + ": restored IconArea RT -> anchor top-center, size 135x120"); sb.AppendLine("  current Image color: " + iconArea.GetComponent<Image>()?.color); UnityEditor.EditorUtility.SetDirty(go); } UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.MarkAllScenesDirty(); return sb.ToString(); } }
